// <auto-generated/>
#nullable enable
using System.Text.Json.Nodes;
using CobolCS.Runtime;
using Microsoft.VisualStudio.TestTools.UnitTesting;
namespace CobolCS.Generated.Tests;
/// <summary>未記入テンプレートを発見せず、固定業務入力・応答・独立期待値を実行します。</summary>
[TestClass]
public sealed class BusinessCasesTests
{
    /// <summary>全ケースの成否を個別に記録します。adopt は TRX と同じ stage の記録を照合します。</summary>
    [TestMethod]
    public void BusinessCases_Run()
    {
        var root = Review.Root();
        var path = Path.Combine(root, "TestResults/business-execution.json");
        Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.GetDirectoryName(path)!);
        var record = new JsonObject { ["complete"] = false, ["cases"] = new JsonArray() };
        void Save() => File.WriteAllText(path, record.ToJsonString());
        Save();
        var items = BusinessCases.Load(root);
        var history = JsonNode.Parse(File.ReadAllText(Path.Combine(root, "Testing/BusinessHistory.json")))!;
        var required = history["requiredCaseIds"]!.AsArray().Select(i => i!.GetValue<string>()).ToArray();
        if (required.Except(items.Select(i => i.Case["caseId"]!.GetValue<string>()), StringComparer.Ordinal).Any()) throw new InvalidOperationException("Required business case deleted");
        if (items.Count == 0)
        {
            Console.WriteLine("Business cases unconfigured; no business correctness evidence.");
            record["complete"] = required.Length == 0;
            Save();
            return;
        }
        var adapters = new Dictionary<string, IBusinessCaseAdapter>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
        BusinessRegistration.Register(adapters);
        foreach (var item in items)
        {
            var id = item.Case["caseId"]!.GetValue<string>();
            var outcome = new JsonObject { ["caseId"] = id, ["status"] = "started" };
            record["cases"]!.AsArray().Add(outcome);
            Save();
            if (File.Exists(Path.Combine(root, "provenance/cobolcs-origin.json")))
            {
                var review = JsonNode.Parse(File.ReadAllText(Path.Combine(root, "Tests/review.json")))!;
                var entry = review["cases"]!.AsArray().Single(c => c!["caseKind"]?.GetValue<string>() == "business" && c["caseId"]!.GetValue<string>() == id)!;
                if (entry["reviewed"]?.GetValue<bool>() != true) throw new InvalidOperationException("Business contract requires explicit review");
                foreach (var pair in entry["files"]!.AsObject().Where(p => p.Key.StartsWith("Tests/BusinessCases/", StringComparison.Ordinal) || p.Key.StartsWith("Tests/BusinessContracts/", StringComparison.Ordinal)))
                {
                    if (Path.IsPathRooted(pair.Key) || pair.Key.Contains('\\') || pair.Key.Split('/').Any(p => p is ".." or "." or "")) throw new InvalidOperationException("Unsafe business review path");
                    if (BusinessCases.FileHash(Path.Combine(root, pair.Key)) != pair.Value!.GetValue<string>()) throw new InvalidOperationException("Business contract/expectations review is stale: " + pair.Key);
                }
                if (entry["files"]?[item.Path] == null) throw new InvalidOperationException("Unbound business case");
            }
            var contractId = item.Case["contractId"]!.GetValue<string>();
            if (!adapters.TryGetValue(contractId, out var adapter)) throw new InvalidOperationException("Missing business adapter " + contractId);
            BusinessCases.Execute(item.Case, item.Contract, adapter);
            outcome["status"] = "passed";
            outcome["caseHash"] = BusinessCases.FileHash(Path.Combine(root, item.Path));
            Save();
        }
        record["complete"] = true;
        Save();
    }
}
